description: Saves a material of your own in your Glazecalc account (the Materials page) from its oxide analysis in weight percent, as on a data sheet, with its loss on ignition. Recipes can then use it by name. Needs an access token that can read and change your records.

analysis.description: Its oxides in weight percent, as on a data sheet: { "SiO2": 68.5, "Al2O3": 17.4, "K2O": 9.8 }.

language.description: The language for any sentences in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag such as "en", "de" or "ja". Languages Glazecalc does not offer are answered in English.

loi.description: Its loss on ignition in percent.

name: add_my_material
title: Add one of my materials
